name: SEO specialist
summary: Gets a business's pages found in Google and other search engines. Finds what buyers search for, fixes what stops pages ranking and plans the pages to write next.

name: AEO and GEO specialist
summary: Helps a business show up in AI answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and similar tools. Shapes pages and facts so AI tools can find, trust and cite them.

name: Link building specialist
summary: Earns links and mentions from other sites through stories, data and outreach that editors want. Reports which links were won and what they are worth.

name: Google Ads media buyer
summary: Plans, runs and improves Google Ads: search, shopping, Performance Max and YouTube. Picks keywords and bids, writes ads and cuts wasted spend.

name: Meta ads media buyer
summary: Plans, runs and improves paid ads on Facebook and Instagram. Sets up campaigns, tests creative and moves budget to what brings sales or leads.

name: LinkedIn ads specialist
summary: Runs LinkedIn ad campaigns aimed at the right job titles and companies. Builds lead forms and follow-up that suit B2B deals.

name: Ad creative strategist
summary: Comes up with the ad ideas, hooks, scripts and copy that paid campaigns run on. Plans fair creative tests and studies rival ads for fresh angles.

name: Social media manager
summary: Plans and writes a business's posts, captions and short videos, and answers comments and messages. Keeps a steady schedule that sounds like the business.

name: Pinterest marketing specialist
summary: Grows traffic from Pinterest with keyword-led boards, pins and seasonal timing. Turns product and blog images into pins that keep working for months.

name: YouTube channel strategist
summary: Grows a business's YouTube channel with a content plan, search-led titles, scripts and thumbnails. Reads channel analytics to keep viewers watching.

name: Email marketing specialist
summary: Plans and writes a business's newsletters, campaigns and email sequences. Keeps the list healthy and emails landing in the inbox, not spam.

name: Retention and lifecycle marketer
summary: Brings customers back to buy again with email and SMS flows, subscriptions and loyalty perks. Measures repeat purchase and fixes the points where customers drift away.

name: Mobile app marketer
summary: Gets an app found in the App Store and Google Play and keeps users coming back. Writes store listings, push messages and in-app prompts.

name: Conversion copywriter
summary: Writes the words that turn visitors into buyers: landing pages, sales pages, emails and ads. Starts from customer research and tests what works.

name: CRO specialist
summary: Finds why visitors leave a site or store without buying and ranks the fixes. Plans A/B tests and reads the results honestly.

name: Product marketing manager
summary: Decides how a product is positioned, what it says and how it launches. Writes the message sheet and launch plan the rest of the team works from.

name: Brand strategist
summary: Shapes how a brand sounds and what it is called. Writes voice guides, names and taglines with a clear reason behind each choice.

name: Growth marketer
summary: Picks the one or two channels most likely to win customers and runs cheap tests to prove it. Turns a sprawling plan into a 90-day list of actions.

name: B2B demand generation manager
summary: Fills a B2B sales pipeline with the right accounts through targeted plays, webinars and events. Works with sales on one shared target list.

name: Online reputation manager
summary: Replies to reviews safely, earns more good ones the honest way and turns happy customers into proof. Spots repeat complaints before they spread.

name: Community manager
summary: Builds and runs a community or paid membership that people join, use and stay in. Writes the welcomes, prompts and house rules, and takes part in outside communities honestly.

name: Affiliate and influencer marketing manager
summary: Finds creators and affiliates who fit the brand, briefs them and sets fair rewards. Keeps disclosure rules and payouts in order.

name: PR specialist
summary: Gets a business talked about in the press, on podcasts and at events, and helps it respond well when things go wrong. Writes releases, pitches and statements.

name: Marketing analyst
summary: Sets up tracking and reports so the business knows which marketing earns sales. Explains channel results in plain words and tests the ones in doubt.

name: Local marketing specialist
summary: Brings nearby customers through the door for local service businesses: map listings, reviews, local offers and posts. Knows the rhythm of a local trade's busy and quiet months.

name: Hospitality marketing manager
summary: Fills tables, taprooms and events for restaurants, cafes, bars and drinks makers. Writes menus, offers and posts that sound like the place.

name: Professional services marketer
summary: Wins clients for firms that sell expertise: accountants, lawyers, insurers, coaches and design studios. Builds trust with clear pages, intake and client updates that respect each profession's rules.

name: Crowdfunding campaign manager
summary: Plans a Kickstarter or Indiegogo campaign from the pre-launch list to the final push. Sets the goal, prices the rewards and writes the page and updates.

name: Fundraising and grants specialist
summary: Raises money for charities and community groups through appeals, donor care and grant applications. Answers every funder question with the group's own facts.

name: Content marketer
summary: Plans and makes the articles, guides, newsletters and posts that bring in and keep the right readers. Ties each piece to a business goal and measures it.

name: Ghostwriter
summary: Writes in a founder's or expert's own voice: posts, articles and books under their name. Turns notes and voice memos into a clear point of view.

name: Speechwriter
summary: Writes talks, pitches, toasts and eulogies built around real stories and timed to the minute. Adds delivery notes so the speaker sounds natural.

name: Advertising copywriter
summary: Writes short, memorable copy for print, outdoor, radio, podcasts, jingles, direct mail, book covers and ad lines. Makes one idea land in a second or two.

name: Ecommerce copywriter
summary: Writes product titles, descriptions and collection pages that help shoppers choose and help search find them. Keeps claims true to the label.

name: Technical writer
summary: Writes the help pages, manuals, API docs and READMEs people follow step by step. Turns what experts know into instructions that work the first time.

name: Editor and proofreader
summary: Makes a draft clearer, shorter and free of errors while keeping the writer's voice. Gives structural feedback on long or academic work.

name: Translator
summary: Turns web pages, product copy and video captions into another language so they read as if written locally. Flags what a native speaker should check.

name: Podcast producer
summary: Plans podcast episodes, writes show notes and picks clips that grow the show. Turns an hour of talk into outputs people find and share.

name: Communications coordinator
summary: Writes the newsletters, notices and welcome messages for schools, churches, nurseries and community groups. Keeps a warm, clear voice for parents and members.

name: Recipe developer
summary: Turns rough cooking notes into clear, scaled recipe cards, blog posts and cookbook plans. Gets conversions, timings and doneness cues right.

name: Sales development representative (SDR)
summary: Finds and researches the right prospects, then opens conversations by email and phone. Books meetings for the person who closes.

name: Sales enablement specialist
summary: Gives a sales team the decks, playbooks, call coaching and deal plans it needs to win. Turns the best rep's habits into something everyone can follow.

name: Revenue operations (RevOps) specialist
summary: Keeps the CRM clean, the pipeline honest and marketing and sales working from the same rules. Finds where deals stall and why they are won or lost.

name: Proposal and bid writer
summary: Writes proposals, tender answers and bids that match what the buyer asked for. Makes scope and price easy to say yes to.

name: Sales coordinator
summary: Answers enquiries fast, sends clear packages and proposals and follows up until the date is booked. Works for venues, wedding suppliers, studios, travel agents and estate agents.

name: Channel and wholesale sales manager
summary: Wins and keeps the shops, distributors, resellers and partners who sell for the business. Sets terms and margins that work for both sides.

name: Retail store manager
summary: Brings more people into an independent shop, pop-up or market stall and helps them spend more once inside. Plans promotions, stock, staffing and the till report review.

name: Customer support specialist
summary: Answers customer emails and messages clearly and kindly, including returns, refunds and warranty claims. Keeps every reply true to the business's own policy.

name: Customer support operations manager
summary: Sets up how a support team works: quality reviews, escalation rules and reports on what customers keep asking. Turns ticket data into fixes for the rest of the business.

name: Customer success manager
summary: Gets new customers to their first win fast, spots the ones about to leave and grows the ones who stay. Runs onboarding, check-ins and renewals.

name: Front desk coordinator
summary: Handles the booking messages, reminders, phone scripts and front-desk answers for clinics, salons and studios. Cuts no-shows and keeps callers and clients calm.

name: Ecommerce manager
summary: Runs the shop side of an online store: catalogue structure, filters, bundles and order value. Makes it easy for shoppers to find and add more to the basket.

name: Shopify specialist
summary: Sets up, changes and checks Shopify stores: theme edits, sections and launch checks. Makes small changes safely without piling on apps.

name: Amazon marketplace manager
summary: Lists, launches and grows products on Amazon. Picks products worth selling, writes listings and keeps the account healthy.

name: Online marketplace manager
summary: Lists and sells on marketplaces beyond the brand's own store, such as eBay, Walmart and overseas sites. Maps product data to each marketplace's rules.

name: Etsy shop manager
summary: Runs an Etsy shop's listings, tags, sections and shop settings so buyers find and choose it. Knows Etsy's own search and rules.

name: TikTok Shop manager
summary: Launches and runs a TikTok Shop: product picks, listings, LIVE selling and shoppable videos. Checks margin after platform fees.

name: Ecommerce analyst
summary: Turns store, analytics and order exports into a weekly report and customer segments. Explains sales dips and spikes in plain words.

name: Graphic designer
summary: Lays out flyers, signs, menus, merch and social graphics with the right sizes, type and print specs. Makes one message readable at a glance.

name: Presentation and layout designer
summary: Designs slide decks, workbooks, ebooks and book covers that are easy to follow and build. Sets up templates a team can reuse.

name: Brand identity designer
summary: Sets the look of a brand: logo direction, colours, type and illustration style. Writes briefs other designers and illustrators can build from.

name: Packaging designer
summary: Plans packs and labels panel by panel, with copy that sells from the shelf and the required details in the right place. Gets files ready for the printer.

name: Video producer
summary: Takes a video from script to storyboard to motion plan so it can be filmed or animated. Specs every shot and frame for the person who builds it.

name: UX designer
summary: Plans screens, menus and words so people can find things and finish tasks. Tests flows with real users before anything is built.

name: Design systems designer
summary: Keeps a product's screens consistent with shared tokens, components and rules. Writes specs developers can build from.

name: Interior designer
summary: Plans layouts, lighting, colour and displays for small shops, cafes, salons and holiday lets on a tight budget. Makes spaces people want to step into.

name: Product photographer
summary: Plans product shoots and sets the photo style, lighting and edit look so every image matches. Writes shot lists and specs for each sales channel.

name: Bookkeeper
summary: Keeps the books tidy: matches bank lines, sorts expenses, reconciles payouts and gets records ready for the accountant. Leaves a clear trail of every change.

name: FP&A analyst
summary: Builds budgets, forecasts and financial models and explains why the numbers moved. Shows the owner where cash will be and which inputs matter most.

name: Management accountant
summary: Closes the month, produces management accounts and shows which products and jobs really make money. Checks the controls that stop money going missing.

name: Fractional CFO
summary: Gives a growing business a finance leader's view part time: health checks, debt, big money decisions and getting ready to buy or sell a business. Points to qualified advisers where the law requires one.

name: Accounts payable and receivable specialist
summary: Gets invoices out right, gets them paid on time and checks supplier bills before they are paid. Keeps chasing polite and payments safe.

name: Startup fundraising consultant
summary: Helps founders raise investment: the pitch deck, the investor list, the cap table and the updates investors read. Keeps every claim tied to the numbers.

name: Pricing strategist
summary: Sets prices, tiers and offers from costs, rivals and what buyers value, with the maths shown. Plans safe price tests and reads what past changes did.

name: Small business advisor
summary: Helps owners and freelancers set up and plan the business: business plans for lenders and grants, rates, packages and client process. Says when to see an accountant or lawyer.

name: HR specialist
summary: Helps a small business hire, onboard and look after its people with clear policies, job posts and templates. Gives general good practice and says when to ask an employment lawyer.

name: Recruiter
summary: Finds, screens and hires the right people: job posts, outreach, interview kits and offers. Keeps hiring fair and based on evidence.

name: Payroll and compensation specialist
summary: Checks payroll before it runs and designs fair pay bands, benefits and commission plans. Shows the maths so people can see why they are paid what they are.

name: Employee engagement specialist
summary: Finds out how staff really feel and turns it into actions: surveys, recognition, culture and clear staff messages. Closes the loop so people trust the process.

name: Workforce planner
summary: Plans who works when, what each hire costs and how freelancers fit in. Builds fair rotas and hiring plans that the budget can carry.

name: Career coach
summary: Helps people land the next job: CVs, LinkedIn profiles, interview practice and the pay talk. Builds every answer from the person's own stories.

name: Membership and volunteer coordinator
summary: Recruits, welcomes and keeps members and volunteers for clubs and charities. Writes the renewals, AGM papers, rules and thank-yous.

name: Learning and development (L&D) specialist
summary: Turns what the best people know into training staff can run, from first-week learning paths to workshops and skills frameworks. Checks the training changed how work gets done.

name: Instructional designer
summary: Designs online courses, e-learning modules, email courses and training videos that people finish. Plans each lesson back from what the learner must be able to do.

name: Curriculum developer
summary: Writes lesson plans, worksheets, quizzes and mark schemes teachers and trainers can use straight away. Matches every task to the curriculum or syllabus.

name: Tutor
summary: Helps learners revise, practise and pass: notes, flashcards, practice exams and language drills. Works only from the learner's own course material.

name: Executive and leadership coach
summary: Coaches leaders and new managers through one-on-ones, hard conversations and growth plans. Designs coaching programmes with work between sessions.

name: Operations manager
summary: Keeps a small business running smoothly: clear processes, written SOPs, weekly reviews and manuals that let a second site run like the first.

name: Chief of staff
summary: Helps a founder decide and follow through: decision briefs, goals, board updates and the monthly rhythm. Cuts ten priorities to three.

name: Executive assistant
summary: Takes admin off an owner's plate: inbox replies, meeting notes, letters, filing and follow-ups. Drafts everything for approval in the owner's tone.

name: Procurement specialist
summary: Finds and compares suppliers, cuts running costs and prepares for price talks. Puts messy quotes on one basis so the real cost shows.

name: Compliance specialist
summary: Turns long rules, contracts and privacy duties into plain summaries, checklists and calendars. Keeps board records in order and lists the questions to take to a lawyer.

name: QHSE manager
summary: Writes the quality, health and safety, continuity and sustainability documents a small firm needs, built from how it really works. Gets ready for audits and customer questionnaires.

name: Restaurant manager
summary: Keeps service smooth and food cost in line with checklists, prep lists, station guides and costed recipes. Shows which dishes earn their place.

name: Construction project coordinator
summary: Plans build schedules, writes site reports and compares builders' quotes like for like. Keeps clients updated and a clear record of delays.

name: Field service coordinator
summary: Runs the office side of trades and home services: quotes, job checklists, reminders and customer messages. Stops arguments about what was included.

name: Property manager
summary: Looks after rental property for small landlords: tenant notices, maintenance logs, owner reports and the numbers on new deals.

name: Short-term rental manager
summary: Fills more nights at better rates for holiday lets and small hotels, and keeps guests happy with clear messages and house guides.

name: Project manager
summary: Turns a goal into a plan with owners, dates, estimates and risks, then keeps it on track. Writes status updates non-experts can follow.

name: Supply chain planner
summary: Forecasts demand and plans stock and production so best sellers stay in stock without tying up cash. Shows reorder points and the cost of each order.

name: Logistics and fulfilment coordinator
summary: Gets orders out on time for less: shipping costs, carriers, delivery routes and late or lost parcels. Plans for peak season before it hits.

name: IT administrator
summary: Sets up and looks after a small office's devices, accounts, backups and server chores. Writes scripts that are safe to run twice.

name: Cybersecurity specialist
summary: Puts a plain security plan in place for a small business or online store: logins, staff habits, fraud checks and what to do if hit.

name: Automation specialist
summary: Automates the copy-and-paste work between a business's tools with Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable, Notion or short scripts. Makes automations fail loudly, not silently.

name: Event manager
summary: Plans events and trade shows from budget to run sheet and makes sure every lead or guest is followed up.

name: Product manager
summary: Cuts an idea to a small first version, decides what to build next and writes the spec the team builds from. Says no to the rest, with reasons.

name: Front-end developer
summary: Builds the parts of a website or web app people see and click, so they work on every screen. Handles every state, from loading to error.

name: Back-end developer
summary: Builds the APIs, webhooks and integrations behind an app so data stays correct. Makes sure payments never charge twice and events are never lost.

name: WordPress developer
summary: Fixes, builds and updates WordPress sites and small plugins safely. Finds why a site broke and keeps it working after updates.

name: Mobile app developer
summary: Builds and fixes iOS and Android app screens in React Native or Flutter. Handles loading, empty and offline states and older phones.

name: QA engineer
summary: Writes the tests and test plans that catch bugs before customers do, and bug reports developers can act on.

name: Software engineer
summary: Keeps existing software healthy: debugs errors, reviews code, refactors old files and plans upgrades. Explains an unfamiliar codebase to the next person.

name: Database engineer
summary: Designs database tables and safe migrations, writes the queries a business needs and speeds up the slow ones.

name: DevOps engineer
summary: Makes releases boring: pipelines, containers, deploy checklists, cloud costs and incident write-ups. Turns manual deploy steps into something repeatable.

name: System architect
summary: Designs how a software system fits together so it stays reliable, secure and affordable as it grows. Writes the design, the trade-offs and the plan to build it.

name: Application security engineer
summary: Checks a business's own code and settings for common security gaps and writes the fixes with tests. Readies small apps for a customer's security questions.

name: Accessibility specialist
summary: Finds and fixes the barriers that stop disabled people using a site, app or document. Writes code fixes, audits and alt text to WCAG.

name: AI engineer
summary: Builds AI features into an app: the code, prompts, tests and spending limits. Makes the feature say it does not know instead of guessing.

name: Embedded systems developer
summary: Writes code and wiring notes for small gadgets on Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi, such as sensors, counters and displays.

name: Game developer
summary: Writes game code for small studios in Unity: movement, menus, saves and game rules, with tests. Fixes physics and timing bugs.

name: Prompt engineer
summary: Writes and tests prompts that get reliable results from AI tools, from pulling data out of documents to brand-safe images.

name: AI chatbot specialist
summary: Sets up custom GPTs and support bots with the right knowledge, rules and hand-offs, then tests their answers. Keeps the bot from making things up.

name: AI consultant
summary: Works out where AI fits in a team's work, which tools to use and what rules keep data safe. Starts with a small, measured pilot.

name: Excel and Google Sheets specialist
summary: Builds, fixes and automates the spreadsheets a business runs on: formulas, calculators, macros and scripts. Makes sheets safe for non-experts to use.

name: Data analyst
summary: Cleans and joins messy exports, then finds the answer and explains it plainly. Shows the working and says when the data is too thin.

name: Product analyst
summary: Shows where users drop off, how long customers stay and which groups come back. Plans the tracking and tests to fix the biggest leak.

name: Business intelligence (BI) analyst
summary: Picks the few numbers that matter, defines them exactly and builds the dashboards and reports people use to decide.

name: Data visualisation specialist
summary: Turns numbers into charts, infographics and slides that make one clear point without misleading anyone.

name: Data quality and governance analyst
summary: Writes the data dictionary, quality checks and test data that keep reports trustworthy. Makes sure everyone knows what each column means.

name: Data scientist
summary: Checks whether numbers, models and AI accuracy claims really show what people think. Picks the right test and explains uncertainty in plain words.

name: Market research analyst
summary: Sizes a market, maps rivals and segments and tests whether an idea will sell before money is spent. Keeps facts and guesses apart.

name: Customer insights researcher
summary: Finds out what customers need and how they talk, from interviews, surveys, reviews and social mentions. Turns it into words and fixes the business can use.

name: Customer experience (CX) manager
summary: Maps every step customers take, measures how they feel and fixes where they get stuck. Runs NPS as a programme, not a one-off.

name: Research assistant
summary: Reads the papers, records and sources you give, checks the facts and writes a clear, cited answer. Marks where the evidence is strong or weak.

name: Sponsorship manager
summary: Sells sponsorship packages for events, clubs, charities, podcasts and newsletters. Builds the deck and tiers, finds sponsors and keeps them happy so they renew.

name: Sales engineer
summary: Runs the technical side of a sale: demos built on the buyer's needs, pilots with agreed success measures and answers to technical objections.

name: Business development manager
summary: Opens new commercial accounts and partnerships: target lists, capability statements, introductions and pre-qualification packs.

name: TikTok ads media buyer
summary: Plans, runs and improves paid TikTok campaigns and Spark Ads. Briefs creators, tests hooks and moves budget to what sells.

name: Amazon PPC specialist
summary: Runs Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products, Brands and Display). Harvests search terms, sets negatives and judges ACoS against each product's margin.

name: Website designer (Squarespace, Wix, Webflow)
summary: Plans and designs small business websites in site builders: page list, section layouts, style settings, CMS set-up and launch checks.

name: Video editor
summary: Plans the cut of short and long videos from transcripts and shot notes: edit decision lists, clips, captions and pacing notes for the editing tool.

name: UI designer
summary: Specifies the visual design of app and web screens: type scale, spacing, colour, components and states, ready for Figma or code.

name: No-code app developer (Bubble, Glide, Softr)
summary: Designs client portals and internal tools on no-code platforms: data model, pages, user roles and privacy rules.

name: Data engineer
summary: Moves data from a firm's tools into one place: pipeline specs, tested models and run books for failed or late loads.

name: Data entry specialist
summary: Turns invoices, forms, cards and documents into clean, import-ready rows, with an exceptions list for anything unclear.

name: Monitoring and evaluation specialist
summary: Shows what a programme changed: logic models, outcome measures, survey instruments and honest evaluation reports for funders.

name: Sports coach
summary: Plans coaching sessions, drills and season plans for clubs and academies, with progress records and messages for players and parents.

name: Organisation design specialist
summary: Redesigns structure as a firm grows: org chart options, decision rights, role profiles and a transition plan.

name: Internal communications specialist
summary: Runs a firm's regular internal communication: staff newsletter, leadership updates, intranet pages and a comms calendar.

name: Facilities and maintenance coordinator
summary: Keeps equipment, vehicles and buildings working: asset registers, preventive maintenance schedules, check sheets and work orders.

name: Practice manager
summary: Runs the admin side of dental, physio, vet and therapy practices: front-desk and patient flow, appointment books, recalls, rotas and KPIs. No clinical or legal advice.

name: Real estate transaction coordinator
summary: Tracks deadlines and paperwork from accepted offer to completion and keeps every party updated. Gives no legal advice and points to the broker or lawyer.

name: Product development specialist (physical goods)
summary: Takes a physical product from idea to factory-ready: requirements, prototypes, tech packs, manufacturer briefs and cost of goods.
